::: {.page-hero}
::: {.page-hero-copy}
# Certificate of completion

The certificate is the public closure of the MGenética trail. It becomes available in the browser when the 12 modules appear as completed in the quizzes.
:::

::: {.page-hero-aside}
**Criterion**

Complete the module quizzes in sequence. Progress is saved locally in your browser.
:::
:::

::: {.public-wayfinding .certificate-wayfinding role="navigation" aria-label="Public guidance for the certificate"}
::: {.public-wayfinding-copy}
**You are at the trail closure**

Use this page to decide whether to recover pending issues, issue the PDF or return to the study route before registering the conclusion.
:::

::: {.public-wayfinding-grid role="list" aria-label="Immediate routes in the certificate"}
::: {.public-wayfinding-item role="listitem"}
**Pending modules**

[View modules](modules/index.qmd){.entry-link aria-label="View pending modules before the certificate"}
:::

::: {.public-wayfinding-item role="listitem"}
**Roadmap**

[Roadmap](semanas/index.qmd){.entry-link aria-label="Open the roadmap before the certificate"}
:::

::: {.public-wayfinding-item role="listitem"}
**Context**

[About](about.qmd){.entry-link aria-label="Understand the public role of the certificate"}
:::
:::
:::

::: {.certificate-intro role="region" aria-label="How the certificate works"}
::: {.certificate-intro-card}
**Completion status**

The certificate only appears when all modules are marked as complete.
:::

::: {.certificate-intro-card}
**Privacy**

Name and date are stored locally in the browser to generate the PDF.
:::

::: {.certificate-intro-card}
**Continuity**

If there are still pending issues, the page indicates the missing modules.
:::
:::

::: {.certificate-scope role="region" aria-label="What the certificate represents"}
::: {.certificate-scope-copy}
**The certificate records completion, does not replace formal assessment**

Use the certificate to close the public trail: it indicates that the quizzes were completed in the browser and that the student completed the proposed sequence. Technical interpretation continues to depend on review, context, and responsible application.
:::

::: {.certificate-scope-grid role="list" aria-label="Limits and uses of the certificate"}
::: {.certificate-scope-item role="listitem"}
**Evidence of route**

Shows that the module sequence has completed locally.
:::

::: {.certificate-scope-item role="listitem"}
**Personal use**

It serves to record study, review and continuity of training.
:::

::: {.certificate-scope-item role="listitem"}
**Clear limit**

It is not professional, institutional or regulatory validation.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.certificate-readiness-guide role="region" aria-label="How to unlock the certificate"}
::: {.certificate-readiness-copy}
## Before generating the certificate

The certificate is not an isolated page: it closes a public study route. Use this screen to check pending issues, return to the right modules and only issue the PDF when the trail is complete.
:::

::: {.certificate-readiness-steps role="list" aria-label="Steps to unlock the certificate"}
::: {.certificate-readiness-step role="listitem"}
**1 · Study**

Follow the 12 modules in order or resume where you left off.
:::

::: {.certificate-readiness-step role="listitem"}
**2 · Validate**

Complete quizzes to record local progress in the browser.
:::

::: {.certificate-readiness-step role="listitem"}
**3 · Generate**

Enter your name and generate the PDF when all modules are complete.
:::
:::

::: {.certificate-readiness-actions role="navigation" aria-label="Routes before issuing the certificate"}
[View modules](modules/index.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}
[Plan study](semanas/index.qmd){.btn .btn-secondary}
[Search a concept](search.qmd){.btn .btn-secondary}
:::
:::

::: {.certificate-decision role="region" aria-label="How to decide whether it is time to issue the certificate"}
::: {.certificate-decision-copy}
**Before issuing, confirm the evidence**

The certificate is most useful when the formal conclusion accompanies a technical synthesis. If you still lack clarity, go back to the right stage before generating the PDF.
:::

::: {.certificate-decision-grid role="list" aria-label="Criteria before issuing the certificate"}
::: {.certificate-decision-item role="listitem"}
**Quizzes**

All modules appear as completed in the browser.
:::

::: {.certificate-decision-item role="listitem"}
**Synthesis**

You can summarize the track in a technical decision.
:::

::: {.certificate-decision-item role="listitem"}
**Next use**

The certificate will be used as a record of study, not as formal validation.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.certificate-evidence-review role="navigation" aria-label="How to review evidence before the certificate"}
::: {.certificate-evidence-review-copy}
**Before the certificate, review what supports the conclusion**

The certificate completes the journey, but the technical evidence becomes stronger when you can point to a representative output of code, table and figure. Use these shortcuts if the conclusion is still generic.
:::

::: {.certificate-evidence-review-grid role="list" aria-label="Technical review routes before the certificate"}
::: {.certificate-evidence-review-item role="listitem"}
**Code**

Review a simple simulation and the decision it supports.

[Review M01](modules/modulo01-introducao-ao-melhoramento-animal.qmd){.entry-link aria-label="Review Module 01 before the certificate"}
:::

::: {.certificate-evidence-review-item role="listitem"}
**Table**

Review a parameter comparison before recording completion.

[Review M06](modules/modulo06-correlacoes-geneticas-e-fenotipicas.qmd){.entry-link aria-label="Review Module 06 before the certificate"}
:::

::: {.certificate-evidence-review-item role="listitem"}
**Figure**

Review a genomic output and the interpretation applied.

[Review M12](modules/modulo12-matrizes-genomicas-gwas-e-predicao-genomica.qmd){.entry-link aria-label="Review Module 12 before the certificate"}
:::
:::
:::

::: {.certificate-recovery role="region" aria-label="How to recover pending issues before the certificate"}
::: {.certificate-recovery-copy}
**If the certificate is not yet available**

Use the backlog as a return guide. The shortest way is to locate the missing module, redo the minimum evidence and validate the quiz in the same browser.
:::

::: {.certificate-recovery-grid role="list" aria-label="Routes to recover certificate pending issues"}
::: {.certificate-recovery-item role="listitem"}
**Pending module**

Return to the index and open the corresponding phase.
:::

::: {.certificate-recovery-item role="listitem"}
**Unsafe concept**

Use search or glossary before retaking the quiz.
:::

::: {.certificate-recovery-item role="listitem"}
**Missing progress**

Make sure you are using the same browser.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.certificate-next-use role="region" aria-label="How to use the certificate after completion"}
::: {.certificate-next-use-copy}
**After PDF, preserve evidence**

The certificate closes the public trail, but the most useful evidence is the synthesis you can explain. Use the PDF along with a short technical note about what you learned and where you would apply the decision.
:::

::: {.certificate-next-use-grid role="list" aria-label="Responsible uses of the certificate"}
::: {.certificate-next-use-item role="listitem"}
**Registration**

Save the date and completed study load.
:::

::: {.certificate-next-use-item role="listitem"}
**Revision**

Return to the phases that still need practice.
:::

::: {.certificate-next-use-item role="listitem"}
**Application**

Take the synthesis to a real analysis with technical review.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.certificate-identity-note role="region" aria-label="How to fill in the name on the certificate"}
::: {.certificate-identity-copy}
**Name on certificate**

The name is only used to render the PDF in the browser. Before generating, check spelling, accents and purpose of the record.
:::

::: {.certificate-identity-grid role="list" aria-label="Care before filling in the certificate"}
::: {.certificate-identity-item role="listitem"}
**Spelling**

Use the name however it appears in the PDF.
:::

::: {.certificate-identity-item role="listitem"}
**Privacy**

The padding remains local in the browser.
:::

::: {.certificate-identity-item role="listitem"}
**Purpose**

Use as a record of study, not a formal credential.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.certificate-final-check role="region" aria-label="Final checklist before generating the certificate"}
::: {.certificate-final-check-copy}
**Last check before generating**

The generate PDF button should be the end of a short review. Confirm the browser, name and purpose of registration before issuing.
:::

::: {.certificate-final-check-grid role="list" aria-label="Items to check before generating the certificate"}
::: {.certificate-final-check-item role="listitem"}
**Browser**

The progress appears complete in this same browser.
:::

::: {.certificate-final-check-item role="listitem"}
**Name**

The spelling is PDF ready.
:::

::: {.certificate-final-check-item role="listitem"}
**Use**

The certificate will be kept as a record of study.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.public-session-check .certificate-session-check role="region" aria-label="Quick check of certificate status"}
::: {.public-session-check-copy}
**Before generating or resuming**

The certificate must clearly indicate whether the action is to continue a pending issue or issue registration.
:::

::: {.public-session-check-grid role="list" aria-label="Certificate check"}
::: {.public-session-check-item role="listitem"}
**Pending**

The next module appears as the main action.
:::

::: {.public-session-check-item role="listitem"}
**Conclusion**

The PDF only appears after 12 quizzes.
:::

::: {.public-session-check-item role="listitem"}
**Registration**

The name and browser were checked.
:::
:::
:::

```{=html}
<div id="cert-gate">
  <noscript>
    <div class="certificate-noscript" role="status">
      <strong>JavaScript required</strong>
      <p>The certificate depends on progress saved locally by quizzes. Activate JavaScript in the browser to check pending issues or generate the PDF.</p>
      <a href="modules/index.html" class="entry-link" aria-label="Return to modules when JavaScript is disabled">Back to modules</a>
    </div>
  </noscript>

  <div id="cert-incomplete" class="certificate-state" hidden>
    <div class="module-objectives certificate-status">
      <h3>Pendant modules</h3>
      <p>Complete all 12 course modules to unlock the certificate.</p>
      <p class="certificate-pending-hint">Use this list as a resumption route: complete the first pending module, return to the quiz and return to the certificate to check your progress.</p>
      <p id="cert-progress-summary" class="certificate-progress-summary" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
      <div id="cert-progress-list" aria-live="polite"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="certificate-actions" aria-describedby="cert-progress-summary">
      <a id="cert-next-pending-link" href="modules/modulo01-introducao-ao-melhoramento-animal.html" class="btn btn-primary">
        Continue with pending issue
      </a>
      <a href="modules/index.html" class="btn btn-secondary">
        View all modules
      </a>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="cert-ready" class="certificate-state" hidden>
    <div class="certificate-ready">
      <div class="hero-kicker">Completed trail</div>
      <h2>You have completed the course</h2>
      <p>All 12 modules were completed by passing the quizzes.</p>
    </div>

    <div id="cert-preview" class="certificate-preview" role="region" aria-label="Certificate preview">
      <div class="certificate-preview-brand">
        <img src="../images/mgenetica-logo-correct.png" alt="MGenética">
        <div class="certificate-preview-kicker">
          MGenética Academy
        </div>

      <div class="certificate-preview-nameband">
        <div class="certificate-preview-label">
          Certifies that
        </div>
        <div id="cert-name" class="certificate-preview-name">
          <!-- filled by JS -->
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="certificate-preview-body">
        completed the course successfully<br>
        <strong>Animal Breeding, Quantitative Genetics<br>and Applied Genomics</strong><br>
        consisting of 12 modules, with passing results in all assessment quizzes.
      </div>

      <div class="certificate-preview-footer">
        <div class="certificate-preview-detail">
          <span>Completion date</span>
          <span id="cert-date"></span>
        </div>
        <div class="certificate-preview-signature">
          <div>
            MGenética Academy
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="certificate-preview-detail certificate-preview-detail-right">
          <span>Estimated workload</span>
          36 hours
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="certificate-form">
      <label for="cert-name-input">

      </label>

      <div class="certificate-form-actions">
        <button id="cert-pdf-btn" class="btn btn-primary">
          Generate PDF
        </button>
        <button id="cert-reset-btn" class="btn btn-secondary">
          Limpar progresso
        </button>

      </p>

</div>
```

<script>
(function () {
'use strict';

var MODULES = [
'modulo01','modulo02','modulo03','modulo04',
'modulo05','modulo06','modulo07','modulo08',
'modulo09','modulo10','modulo11','modulo12'
  ];

var MODULE_TITLES = {
module01: 'Introduction to Animal Improvement',
module02: 'Bases of Quantitative Genetics',
modulo03: 'Descriptive Statistics and Data Exploration in R',
module04: 'Means, Variances and Variance Components',
module05: 'Heritability and Repeatability',
module06: 'Genetic and Phenotypic Correlations',
module07: 'Linear Models and Mixed Models',
module08: 'BLUP and Genetic Assessment',
module09: 'Pedigree and Kinship Structure',
module10: 'Introduction to Genomics and SNP Markers',
module11: 'Genomic Data Quality Control',
module12: 'Genomic Arrays, GWAS and Genomic Prediction'
  };

var MODULE_LINKS = {
modulo01: 'modules/modulo01-introducao-ao-melhoramento-animal.html',
modulo02: 'modules/modulo02-bases-da-genetica-quantitativa.html',
modulo03: 'modules/modulo03-estatistica-descritiva-e-exploracao-de-dados-no-r.html',
modulo04: 'modules/modulo04-medias-variancias-e-componentes-de-variancia.html',
modulo05: 'modules/modulo05-herdabilidade-e-repetabilidade.html',
modulo06: 'modules/modulo06-correlacoes-geneticas-e-fenotipicas.html',
modulo07: 'modules/modulo07-modelos-lineares-e-modelos-mixos.html',
modulo08: 'modules/modulo08-blup-e-avaliacao-genetica.html',
modulo09: 'modules/modulo09-estrutura-de-pedigree-e-parentesco.html',
modulo10: 'modules/modulo10-introducao-a-genomica-e-marcadores-snp.html',
modulo11: 'modules/modulo11-controle-de-qualidade-de-dados-genomicos.html',
modulo12: 'modules/modulo12-matrizes-genomicas-gwas-e-predicao-genomica.html'
  };

function getCompleted() {
try {
var api = window.mgenetica;
if (api && api.getCompleted) return api.getCompleted();
} catch (_) {}
try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('mgenetica_completed')) || []; }
catch (_) { return []; }
  }

function init() {
var completed = getCompleted();
var pending = MODULES.filter(function (m) { return !completed.includes(m); });

if (pending.length > 0) {
showIncomplete(completed, pending);
} else {
showReady();
    }
  }

function showIncomplete(completed, pending) {
document.getElementById('cert-incomplete').hidden = false;
var summary = document.getElementById('cert-progress-summary');
if (summary) {
summary.textContent = completed.length + ' of ' + MODULES.length + ' completed modules. Next pending: ' + formatModuleLabel(pending[0]) + '.';
    }
updateNextPendingAction(pending[0]);
var list = document.getElementById('cert-progress-list');
var wrapper = document.createElement('ul');
wrapper.className = 'certificate-progress-list';
MODULES.forEach(function (m) {
var done = completed.includes(m);
var moduleLabel = formatModuleLabel(m);
var title = MODULE_TITLES[m] || m;
var href = MODULE_LINKS[m];
var item = document.createElement('li');
var state = document.createElement('span');
var module = document.createElement('span');
var titleWrap = document.createElement('span');
item.className = 'certificate-progress-item ' + (done ? 'is-complete' : 'is-pending');
state.className = 'certificate-progress-state';
state.textContent = done ? 'Completed' : 'Pending';
module.className = 'certificate-progress-module';
module.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
module.textContent = moduleLabel;
titleWrap.className = 'certificate-progress-title';
if (href) {
var link = document.createElement('a');
link.href = href;
link.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Open ' + moduleLabel + ': ' + title);
link.textContent = title;
titleWrap.appendChild(link);
} else {
titleWrap.textContent = title;
}
item.appendChild(state);
item.appendChild(module);
item.appendChild(titleWrap);
wrapper.appendChild(item);
    });
list.textContent = '';
list.appendChild(wrapper);
  }

function formatModuleLabel(moduleId) {
return moduleId.replace('modulo', 'M').toUpperCase();
  }

function updateNextPendingAction(moduleId) {
var link = document.getElementById('cert-next-pending-link');
if (!link || !moduleId) return;
var moduleLabel = formatModuleLabel(moduleId);
var title = MODULE_TITLES[moduleId] || moduleId;
link.href = MODULE_LINKS[moduleId] || 'modules/index.html';
link.textContent = 'Continue ' + moduleLabel;
link.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Continue by ' + moduleLabel + ': ' + title);
  }

function showReady() {
document.getElementById('cert-ready').hidden = false;

var dateEl = document.getElementById('cert-date');
var stored = localStorage.getItem('mgenetica_cert_date');
if (!stored) {
stored = new Date().toLocaleDateString('pt-BR', { day:'2-digit', month:'long', year:'numeric' });
localStorage.setItem('mgenetica_cert_date', stored);
    }
dateEl.textContent = stored;

var nameInput = document.getElementById('cert-name-input');
var certName = document.getElementById('cert-name');

var savedName = localStorage.getItem('mgenetica_cert_name') || '';
nameInput.value = savedName;
certName.textContent = savedName || 'Your name';

nameInput.addEventListener('input', function () {
certName.textContent = nameInput.value.trim() || 'Your name';
nameInput.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
nameInput.style.borderColor = '';
    });

document.getElementById('cert-pdf-btn').addEventListener('click', generatePDF);
document.getElementById('cert-reset-btn').addEventListener('click', function () {
if (confirm('This will erase all your progress. Are you sure?')) {
localStorage.removeItem('mgenetica_completed');
localStorage.removeItem('mgenetica_cert_date');
localStorage.removeItem('mgenetica_cert_name');
location.reload();
      }
    });
  }

function generatePDF() {
var nameInput = document.getElementById('cert-name-input');
var name = nameInput.value.trim();
if (!name) {
nameInput.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
nameInput.focus();
nameInput.style.borderColor = 'var(--mg-red,#e53e3e)';
return;
    }
nameInput.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
nameInput.style.borderColor = '';
localStorage.setItem('mgenetica_cert_name', name);

var script = document.createElement('script');
script.src = 'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jspdf/2.5.1/jspdf.umd.min.js';
script.onload = function () { buildPDF(name); };
script.onerror = function () {
alert('Unable to load PDF library. Check your connection.');
    };
document.body.appendChild(script);
  }

function buildPDF(name) {
/* global jspdf */
var jsPDF = window.jspdf ? window.jspdf.jsPDF : window.jsPDF;
var doc = new jsPDF({ orientation: 'landscape', unit: 'mm', format: 'a4' });
var W = 297, H = 210;

// Background
doc.setFillColor(255, 255, 255);
doc.rect(0, 0, W, H, 'F');

// Top & bottom navy bar
doc.setFillColor(13, 38, 66);
doc.rect(0, 0, W, 8, 'F');
doc.rect(0, H - 6, W, 6, 'F');

// Border
doc.setDrawColor(13, 38, 66);
doc.setLineWidth(0.6);
doc.rect(10, 12, W - 20, H - 22);

// Header label
doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
doc.setFontSize(9);
doc.setTextColor(37, 99, 168);
doc.text('MGENETICA ACADEMY', W/2, 26, { align: 'center' });

// Make sure
doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal');
doc.setFontSize(11);
doc.setTextColor(90, 122, 154);
doc.text('Certificates that', W/2, 42, { align: 'center' });

// Name
doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bolditalic');
doc.setFontSize(28);
doc.setTextColor(13, 38, 66);
doc.text(name, W/2, 60, { align: 'center' });

// Divider
doc.setDrawColor(200, 216, 234);
doc.setLineWidth(0.3);
doc.line(40, 66, W - 40, 66);

// Body text
doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal');
doc.setFontSize(11);
doc.setTextColor(26, 58, 92);
doc.text('completed the course successfully', W/2, 78, { align: 'center' });

doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
doc.setFontSize(14);
doc.setTextColor(13, 38, 66);
doc.text('Animal Breeding, Quantitative Genetics and Applied Genomics', W/2, 88, { align: 'center' });

doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal');
doc.setFontSize(10);
doc.setTextColor(90, 122, 154);
doc.text('comprised of 12 modules, with approval in all assessment quizzes.', W / 2, 98, { align: 'center' });

// Bottom row
var dateStored = localStorage.getItem('mgenetica_cert_date') ||
new Date().toLocaleDateString('pt-BR', { day: '2-digit', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' });

doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
doc.setFontSize(9);
doc.setTextColor(13, 38, 66);
doc.text('Completion date', 50, H - 28);
doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal');
doc.setTextColor(90, 122, 154);
doc.text(dateStored, 50, H - 22);

doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
doc.setFontSize(9);
doc.setTextColor(13, 38, 66);
doc.text('Estimated workload', W - 50, H - 28, { align: 'right' });
doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal');
doc.setTextColor(90, 122, 154);
doc.text('36 hours', W - 50, H - 22, { align: 'right' });

// Signature line
doc.setDrawColor(13, 38, 66);
doc.setLineWidth(0.3);
doc.line(W/2 - 35, H - 22, W/2 + 35, H - 22);
doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal');
doc.setFontSize(8);
doc.setTextColor(90, 122, 154);
doc.text('MGenética Academy', W/2, H - 17, { align: 'center' });

doc.save('certificado-mgenetica-' + name.replace(/\s+/g, '-').toLowerCase() + '.pdf');
  }

// Wait for progress tracker to be available
if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () { setTimeout(init, 100); });
} else {
setTimeout(init, 100);
  }
})();
</script>
